description: Fires when the player to move has two or more of their own stones stacked on top of column 0 (leftmost), with the cell above empty and room to reach four. Three stacked (an immediate vertical win) is far stronger. Other columns, the opponent's stack, a single stone or a stack without room do not fire; an opponent threat cell higher in column 0 suppresses it.
effect: Raises the probability of playing column 0 (about +0.12 to +0.15 when forced to max); zeroing it on a 3-stack win cuts column 0 from 0.77 to 0.30.
notes: p1 (run>=2 on top of col 0 with room) F1 0.795; adding opponent-threat-above-in-col-0 exclusion F1 0.830 then 0.836 (P 0.74 R 0.96, AUROC 0.97, sim share 1.69). Minimal pairs: same stack in cols 1/3/6 does nothing; capping by opponent kills it; no room kills it. Two-stack strength varies 1-12 with context I could not pin down (some late-game decay, opponent urgent threats lower it).
